elements_selected.content: Implement SPL-specific theory cache invalidation using AST hashes per REQ-040. During zetl reason status (and any other theory-building command): 1) Collect the set of SPL leaf AST hashes from the current Merkle tree (from all SPL-containing files), 2) Compare against the set stored in theory.json spl_blocks (the ast_hash fields), 3) If the sets are identical (same labels, same hashes), the theory cache is valid — skip rebuild, 4) If any ast_hash differs or any file is added/removed, rebuild the theory. This means a prose-only edit (file Merkle root changes, but SPL AST hash unchanged) does NOT trigger a theory rebuild. Implement as a theory_cache_valid(current_spl_hashes, cached_theory) -> bool function in cache.rs. Wire this into cmd_reason_status in main.rs before the theory build step.
